visuals.character: Blue pirate with dark tricorne, goggles/glasses, blue coat with cyan scarf ribbons and glowing circular holographic brain rune held up in hand.
visuals.backdrop: Midnight blue ship deck and rigging, blue star-speckled sky, glowing lamp near center lower third.
visuals.accent_sections: Bright blue persona title, translucent royal blue tagline, cyan-edged strength panel and trait bullets, violet icon for data-science secondary card.

common_layout.layout_reference: Result screenshot portrays character occupying left 45%, content stacked right with track-colored accents. Mobile version must reorganize to readable vertical sections rather than shrinking screenshot.

common_header.behavior: Use navigator.share if supported; otherwise copy absolute result link and announce copied state; use actual saved result ID if result is private.

content_sections.treatment: extra-large bold in primary track color

content_sections.label: قوتك الفريدة
content_sections.treatment: outlined card with large track icon

content_sections.label: خصائصك المميزة
content_sections.treatment: 4 bullet traits with colored diamond markers

content_sections.label: المسار المقترح الثانوي
content_sections.treatment: bordered lower card with icon, title and description

mobile_layout.container: Single-column scrollable portrait result (not a flattened screenshot).
mobile_layout.topbar: Logo top-start, share button top-end with 44px hit area; both retain sufficient contrast.
mobile_layout.hero: Show pirate character as standalone illustrated figure in upper hero stage (~240-350px), with dark gradient behind text. Persona title can be above or immediately after artwork as long as readability is preserved.
mobile_layout.copy: Stack tagline, strength, traits and secondary card with 12-20px vertical gaps; max 100% available width, at least 16px side padding.
mobile_layout.text: Use centered title but section descriptions right-aligned RTL; avoid text on top of bright character silhouette.
mobile_layout.share: Provide optional fixed lower safe-area share CTA only if it does not obscure content.

tablet_desktop_layout.scene: Preserve dock, pirate flag, lantern and ship silhouettes as subtle atmosphere.

share_card.rendering: If adding save/share image, compose purpose-built poster from approved assets and real text; do not screenshot offscreen content prematurely.
share_card.privacy: Do not share response text or profile identifiers by default.

actions.share: Web Share API or copy URL

accessibility: Heading order h1 for persona and h2 for sections.
Character art decorative unless it communicates unique information.
Track meaning must be communicated via name/icon, not only color.
